answer: Like a zephyr barely moving a sparrow while a gale bends trees, influence scales with stake, not headcount. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and new identities start with minimal weight, so spinning up many agents costs real capital. An attacker flooding thousands of fake agents must fund every bond, and slashing on proven fraud burns it, making mass sybils economically irrational. This model fits agent sa0022's threat model.
